title: Virtual screening and activity evaluation of novel ecdysone analogues targeting overlapping binding pockets in Lepidoptera ecdysone receptor.
authors: Feng, Yanjiao; Cui, Jialin; Wang, Hongyan; Tan, Qinyan; Liu, Shangzhong; Liu, Libing; Zhang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究昆虫蜕皮激素受体（EcR/USP）与小分子配体的虚拟筛选和结合活性，属于蛋白-小分子互作，而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The ecdysone receptor (EcR/USP) plays a vital role in regulating molting and metamorphosis in insects, rendering it an attractive green target for developing novel insect growth regulators (IGRs). In this study, the ligand pharmacophore model S1&S2 and the Combine active pockets were constructed on the basis of the two different ligand-binding pockets of Lepidoptera EcR. A multi-level virtual screening of the SPECS database was performed, using pesticide-likeness rule and molecular docking, to obtain 13 screening compounds. Then, a novel experimental method was established to evaluate Plutella xylostella EcR/USP-LBD binding to ligand molecules using the Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) technique. The binding assays demonstrated that compounds VS-13, VS-16, VS-17, VS-18, and VS-19 exhibited comparable or superior efficacy to the commercial insecticide methoxyfenozide. Notably, VS-13 showed the highest binding activity, with a K(d) of 0.2 +/- 0.03 muM, similar to Ponesterone A (PonA, K(d) = 0.1 +/- 0.01 muM). Furthermore, molecular docking studies revealed that, in addition to three important residues (Asn503, Tyr407, and Thr342), Trp525 and Met379 are also key residues in stable the ligand-receptor interactions. These findings provide an effective strategy to design and discovery novel non-ecdysteroid analogs targeting lepidopteran insects.
abstract_zh: 蜕皮激素受体（EcR/USP）在昆虫蜕皮和变态调控中发挥关键作用，使其成为开发新型昆虫生长调节剂（IGRs）的绿色靶标。本研究基于鳞翅目昆虫EcR的两个不同配体结合口袋，构建了配体药效团模型S1&S2及组合活性口袋。利用农药类药性规则和分子对接，对SPECS数据库进行了多层次虚拟筛选，获得13个筛选化合物。随后，建立了一种新的实验方法，利用表面等离子体共振（SPR）技术评估小菜蛾EcR/USP-LBD与配体分子的结合。结合实验表明，化合物VS-13、VS-16、VS-17、VS-18和VS-19表现出与商业杀虫剂甲氧虫酰肼相当或更优的效力。值得注意的是，VS-13显示出最高的结合活性，其K(d)为0.2 ± 0.03 μM，与蜕皮甾酮A（PonA，K(d) = 0.1 ± 0.01 μM）相似。此外，分子对接研究揭示，除了三个重要残基（Asn503、Tyr407和Thr342）外，Trp525和Met379也是稳定配体-受体相互作用的关键残基。这些发现为设计和发现靶向鳞翅目昆虫的新型非蜕皮甾体类似物提供了有效策略。
